target_customer: US private medical practices, surgery centers and billing teams, especially behavioral health, physical therapy and neurology
problem: Practices lose revenue to eligibility errors, billing errors and underpayments, and patients rarely know their costs in advance.
business_model: B2B SaaS revenue cycle automation that runs inside the practice's existing EMR

founders.name: Sho Sugihara
prior_employers: McKinsey (healthcare data analytics, including NHS and private insurers)
previous_startups: Fintech startup co-founded, multi-million ARR within 12 months per YC launch post

founders.name: Oscar Wilsby
education: Cambridge, MEng and PhD in machine learning and computational physics
previous_startups: Co-founded and scaled a startup to a multi-million run rate (name not given)

technical_complexity.rationale: Checking payer portals, calling payers and scrubbing claims inside several EMRs needs integrations and compliance work (HIPAA, SOC 2) but uses established methods. The CTO has a machine learning PhD.

defensibility.rationale: EMR integrations help, but many funded startups sell eligibility and intake automation and the underlying AI tools are widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Larger funded players kept expanding in patient access automation.

market_need_then: The founders cite patients not knowing costs and providers losing revenue to billing errors and underpayments. Funded players such as Notable (reported $100M Series B) and Infinitus show spend on the category.

branding.domain_note: Uses fuseinsight.com, a suffix domain; the company is also called Fuse Insight.

identity.logo: White FUSE wordmark with purple squares
identity.visual_style: Purple color scheme and geometric grids
identity.voice_and_tone: Practical and compliance focused (zero IT changes, HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II)

branding.community_and_virality: Won the ViVE 2025 Startup Pitch Competition (February 2025) and named to HIMSS Emerge 2025 Winner's Circle, per the company blog. No evidence of merch or fans.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic name shared with other companies (YC also lists a separate 'fuse ai') and no evidence the brand drove growth.

pivots.from: AI analysis of healthcare contracts and payments to detect underpayments
pivots.to: Eligibility, benefits checks, intake and claims automation inside the EMR
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from the changed YC and website descriptions

outcome_analysis: Fuse is a three to four person team that joined YC in Summer 2024 and has moved from underpayment detection toward broader revenue cycle automation. It won a startup pitch competition in early 2025 and holds SOC 2 Type II, but no funding, customer counts or exit were found, so the outcome is still open.
notes: CB Insights snippet reports about 500K raised with Speedinvest, Transpose Platform, MasterCard Start Path and Delight Ventures; single aggregator, unverified, so not recorded as a round. Company blog names only Y Combinator as investor. Competitor list empty: searches found no sources dated near July 2024 for rivals, only later material. Location conflict between London (YC) and San Francisco (press release dateline). The pivot is inferred from differing descriptions.
